notes.title: New Block Variants, Main Menu and UI Fixes
notes.notes:
-Added new block variants:
	Friction Block Sloped
	Friction Block Edgeless
	Friction Block Edge

-Added a main menu so the game doesn't start right away.

-Fixed a problem that caused some words to not appear.

notes.title: Tutorial Videos
notes.notes:
-Added a section to the Info Panel(F1 key) called "Tutorials".Currently it contains a link to a Youtube channel that contains Custom Machinery building tutorials.There will be more videos uploaded in the coming days.
Link to the channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaU3yyBqrxj1NUEqNO05o7g]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaU3yyBqrxj1NUEqNO05o7g[/url]

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.notes: A bug that caused step sound repeating constantly is fixed.

notes.title: Info Panel
notes.notes: Added a sign to indicate how to open the info panel. The Info panel contains the controls and can be accessed with F1 key.
